correctness.rationale: Every symmetric unimodal integer law is reconstructed exactly as a convex mixture of centered discrete uniforms. Their variance/fourth-moment points satisfy q=(9v^2-v)/5. Strict convexity makes the chord between adjacent variance grid points the exact lower hull, with equality only for the adjacent mixture. The phase law follows from the exact cell width.
